title: CoPersona: Collaborative Persona Graphs for Robust LLM Personalization

problem.claim: LLM personalization is constrained by sparse and skewed user histories, which provide incomplete and biased evidence about user preferences.

gap.claim: Weakly observed user attributes are difficult to infer, causing brittle personalization when test-time requests shift toward under-supported facets.

narrative_sequence.summary: Real-world LLM personalization faces sparse and skewed user histories.
Insufficient support for user attributes makes personalization brittle under shifts toward under-supported facets.

source_observation.claim: Sparse and biased interaction histories provide incomplete evidence about user preferences.

interpretation.claim: Personalization systems should account for uncertainty caused by uneven user observation.

application.claim: Evaluate personalization robustness on requests involving facets that are weakly supported in the observed history.

exception.claim: The supplied abstract units do not specify which robustness mechanisms or evaluation settings address this issue.

unknowns: The proposed method and its contribution type are not described.
No author-reported empirical results, datasets, baselines, or quantitative findings are supplied.
The meaning of collaborative persona graphs is not specified.
